camel_example: aliyun ossutil api list-multipart-uploads --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou

CommonPrefix.description_en: If the delimiter parameter is specified in the request, the response from OSS contains the CommonPrefixes element. This element indicates a set of object names that end with the delimiter and share a common prefix
CommonPrefix.description_zh: 如果请求中指定了delimiter参数，则OSS返回的响应中包含CommonPrefixes元素。该元素标明以delimiter结尾，并有共同前缀的Object名称的集合

Prefix.description_en: The common prefix of the query results
Prefix.title: The prefix that the names of returned objects contain

CommonPrefix.title: Objects whose names contain the same string that ranges from the prefix to the next occurrence of the delimiter are grouped as a single result

Upload.description_en: The container that stores information about multipart upload events
Upload.description_zh: 保存Multipart Upload事件信息的容器

Initiated.description_en: The time when the multipart upload event was initiated
Initiated.description_zh: Multipart Upload事件初始化的时间
Initiated.title: description

Key.description_en:
The name of the object for which the multipart upload event is initiated.



The returned results are sorted in alphabetical order by object name. For the same object, the results are sorted in alphabetical order by upload ID
Key.description_zh:
初始化Multipart Upload事件的Object名称。



OSS的返回结果按照Object名称字典序升序排列，对于同一个Object，则按照UploadId的字典序升序排列
Key.title: description

UploadId.description_en: The ID of the multipart upload event
UploadId.title: description

Upload.title: A short description of struct

description_en: Lists all in-progress multipart upload events
description_zh: 列举所有执行中的Multipart Upload事件
name: ListMultipartUploads

parameters.help_en: The character used to group object names. All objects whose names contain the specified prefix and between which the delimiter character appears for the first time are grouped as a CommonPrefixes element
parameters.help_zh: 用于对Object名称进行分组的字符。所有名称包含指定的前缀且首次出现delimiter字符之间的Object作为一组元素CommonPrefixes
parameters.name: delimiter

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of multipart upload events returned in this request. Default value: 1000. Maximum value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回Multipart Upload事件的最大个数，默认值为1000。最大值为1000
parameters.name: max_uploads

parameters.help_en:
Used together with the upload-id-marker parameter to specify the starting position of the returned results.
If the upload-id-marker parameter is not set, the query results include all multipart upload events whose object names are lexicographically greater than the key-marker parameter value.
If the upload-id-marker parameter is set, the query results include:
    - All multipart upload events whose object names are lexicographically greater than the key-marker parameter value.
    - Multipart upload events whose object names are equal to the key-marker parameter value but whose UploadId is greater than the upload-id-marker parameter value
parameters.help_zh:
与upload-id-marker参数配合使用，用于指定返回结果的起始位置。
如果未设置upload-id-marker参数，查询结果中包含所有Object名称的字典序大于key-marker参数值的Multipart Upload事件。
如果设置了upload-id-marker参数，查询结果中包含：
    - 所有Object名称的字典序大于key-marker参数值的Multipart Upload事件。
    - Object名称等于key-marker参数值，但是UploadId比upload-id-marker参数值大的Multipart Upload事件
parameters.name: key_marker

parameters.help_en:
Specifies that the returned object keys must be prefixed with this value. Note that when you use the prefix parameter for a query, the returned keys still contain the prefix.
You can use the prefix parameter to group and manage objects in a bucket (similar to a folder feature)
parameters.help_zh:
限定返回的Object Key必须以prefix作为前缀。注意使用prefix查询时，返回的Key中仍会包含prefix。
您可以灵活地使用prefix参数对Bucket内的Object进行分组管理（类似文件夹功能）
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en:
Used together with the key-marker parameter to specify the starting position of the returned results.
If the key-marker parameter is not set, OSS ignores the upload-id-marker parameter.
If the key-marker parameter is set, the query results include:
    - All multipart upload events whose object names are lexicographically greater than the key-marker parameter value.
    - Multipart upload events whose object names are equal to the key-marker parameter value but whose UploadId is greater than the upload-id-marker parameter value
parameters.help_zh:
与key-marker参数配合使用，用于指定返回结果的起始位置。
如果未设置key-marker参数，则OSS会忽略upload-id-marker参数。
如果设置了key-marker参数，查询结果中包含：
    - 所有Object名称的字典序大于key-marker参数值的Multipart Upload事件。
    - Object名称等于key-marker参数值，但是UploadId比upload-id-marker参数值大的Multipart Upload事件
parameters.name: upload_id_marker

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the encoding type for the returned content. The Delimiter, KeyMarker, Prefix, NextKeyMarker, and Key elements use UTF-8 characters, but XML 1.0 does not support parsing certain control characters, such as characters with ASCII values from 0 to 10. For control characters that are not supported by the XML 1.0 standard, you can specify encoding-type to encode the returned Delimiter, KeyMarker, Prefix, NextKeyMarker, and Key elements.

Default value: none
parameters.help_zh:
指定对返回的内容进行编码，指定编码的类型。Delimiter、KeyMarker、Prefix、NextKeyMarker和Key使用UTF-8字符，但xml 1.0标准不支持解析一些控制字符，例如ASCII值从0到10的字符。对于包含xml
                              1.0标准不支持的控制字符，可以通过指定encoding-type对返回的Delimiter、KeyMarker、Prefix、NextKeyMarker和Key进行编码。

默认值：无
parameters.name: encoding_type

schema.description_en: The response body that contains the results of the ListMultipartUpload request
schema.description_zh: 保存ListMultipartUpload请求结果的响应体

ListMultipartUploadsResult.description_en: The container that stores the results of the ListMultipartUpload request

CommonPrefixes.description_en: The list that stores common prefixes of object names in the listing results
CommonPrefixes.description_zh: 保存列举结果中Object名称公共前缀的列表

items.description_en: The container that stores common prefixes of object names in the listing results
items.description_zh: 保存列举结果中Object名称公共前缀的容器

Delimiter.description_en: The object name grouping character used in this query
Delimiter.description_zh: 本次查询所用的Object名称分组字符

EncodingType.description_en: The encoding type used in the returned results. If the encoding-type request parameter is specified, the Delimiter, KeyMarker, Prefix, NextKeyMarker, and Key elements in the response are encoded
EncodingType.description_zh: 指明返回结果中编码使用的类型。如果请求参数中指定了encoding-type，那返回的结果会对Delimiter、KeyMarker、Prefix、NextKeyMarker和Key这些元素进行编码

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the returned multipart upload result list is truncated. Valid values:

true: Not all results are returned.

false (default): All results are returned
IsTruncated.description_zh:
表示本次返回的MultipartUpload结果列表是否被截断。取值范围如下：

true：表示本次没有返回全部结果。

false（默认）：表示本次已经返回了全部结果

KeyMarker.description_en: The starting object position of the list

MaxUploads.description_en: The maximum number of uploads returned

NextKeyMarker.description_en: If not all results are returned, the response includes the NextKeyMarker element to indicate the KeyMarker value for the next request
NextKeyMarker.description_zh: 如果本次没有返回全部结果，响应请求中将包含NextKeyMarker元素，用于表示接下来请求的KeyMarker值

NextUploadIdMarker.description_en: If not all results are returned, the response includes the NextUploadMarker element to indicate the UploadMarker value for the next request
NextUploadIdMarker.description_zh: 如果本次没有返回全部结果，响应请求中将包含NextUploadMarker元素，用于表示接下来请求的UploadMarker值

Prefix.description_en: The prefix used in this query

Upload.description_en: The list that stores multipart upload event information
Upload.description_zh: 保存Multipart Upload事件信息的列表

items.description_en: The container that stores multipart upload event information
items.description_zh: 保存Multipart Upload事件信息的容器

UploadIdMarker.description_en: The starting UploadId position of the list
